title: 3dpc.c: Python SOS node wire form -> full AddrForKey address string (spec 18.4.2)
description: Child of 3dpc. spec/12-apps.md 18.4.2: alert node field is the originating node's full 0200:: IPv6 address string ('0200:...'); C codec validate_node_id (sos_alert.c:314) already requires this 8-colon-group form, but Python emergency.py:227-236 requires len==16 bare hex IID chars - the wire divergence. In python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py render_post (and cancel/delete paths): parse from_hex/body node as IPv6Address; binding gate becomes parsed_addr == yggdrasil_address(pubkey) (replaces _pubkey_to_iid(pubkey)==iid); trust_store.verify_or_pin(pubkey, _pubkey_to_iid(pubkey)) - IID is a pure pubkey function; accounting source_key becomes the 16-byte parsed address (spec: key = full 16-byte source, MUST NOT extract IID). Update _signed_body helpers in test_sos_resource.py + test_security_app_vector_consumers.py + test_vector_consumers_lci.py and all 16-hex expectations. Independent of 3dpc.b (Python emit + verify parity); C<->Python SOS interop completes when both land. Verify: pytest SOS suites + full coap suite green.
close_reason: Migrated Python /sos to spec 18.4.2/18.4.1 form: node = full 0200:: AddrForKey string; binding gate = parsed == yggdrasil_address(pubkey); transcript + accounting keys use full 16-byte packed address; trust pin keeps IID (pure pubkey function). 4 files changed (emergency.py + 3 test files). Verified: 176 SOS tests pass; target suites 293 passed/6 pre-existing Confessions failures; tests/coap/ failure set byte-identical to pre-change baseline (83 pre-existing). lora_medium collection error is pre-existing environment gap.
